experimental_dialogue_safe_audio.problem: H3 may generate extra unrequested speech after the requested line while the same stereo master still contains wanted music, ambience, and sound effects; trimming the whole master at the speech boundary destroys those wanted sounds.

boundary_analyzer.behavior: local CPU faster-whisper reports a boundary only when exactly one contiguous exact normalized target sequence is present
boundary_analyzer.ambiguous_repetition: rejected rather than selecting the first or last occurrence
boundary_analyzer.tail_energy: reported only as signal activity, never classified as speech

safe_master.required_inputs: an already verified independent speech stem plus optional independent full-duration music, ambience, and SFX stems
safe_master.default_fit_policy: strict; no stem is silently looped, padded, or trimmed
safe_master.guarantee: the final master is not truncated at the speech end

timed_background_bed_lock.workflow: two-pass H3 helper using an independent full-duration background bed
timed_background_bed_lock.boundary: ceil-quantized to the 40Hz H3 audio latent grid so locking never begins earlier than requested
timed_background_bed_lock.mask_contract: video stream remains unchanged; an existing audio noise mask is a cap, so the node does not increase generation freedom

real_four_step_probe.environment: RTX 4060 Ti 16GiB; ComfyUI 0.31.0 at cbbc9dab1; DynamicVRAM
real_four_step_probe.model: FL2VA pruned INT8; Qwen3-VL NVFP4; H3 Audio VAE
real_four_step_probe.audio_fit: Audio Window encoded to T=206 versus AV target T=207; strict rejected and fit_reported explicitly zero-padded one latent step
real_four_step_probe.decoded_boundary_observation: H3 Audio VAE temporal context produced material difference for roughly the first 0.3 seconds after the latent boundary; later windows were near-equal but not bit-identical

timed_background_bed_lock.status: real four-step H3 sampling validated the locked latent endpoint within 1e-6; decoded perceptual quality and seamlessness remain unvalidated

scientific_limits: No source separation is performed; an already mixed H3 master cannot be safely repaired by these nodes alone.
Music-vocal separators are not assumed to be dialogue removers and may remove intentional singing or damage music/SFX.
A 40Hz latent boundary is not a sample-exact decoded speech endpoint because the audio VAE has temporal context.
Prompt directions and latent locking do not guarantee that the visible character stops mouth motion.
experimental_dialogue_safe_audio.compatibility: all prior 51 node IDs, ordering, defaults, and execution paths are unchanged; three opt-in EXP nodes are appended

sampling.algorithm: selectable sampler and scheduler with a backward-compatible dual-clock default
sampling.sampler_options: current comfy.samplers.SAMPLER_NAMES when native ModelSamplingAV is available
sampling.alternate_sampler_protocol: native FLOW_AV carry/scale; unavailable on legacy ComfyUI
sampling.legacy_workflow_compatibility: new optional widgets are appended after steps/shift_video/shift_audio
comfyui_audio_velocity_compatibility: current FLOW_AV raw H3 audio velocity

experimental_sampling.video_update_policy: one frozen-derivative macro update per video step
comfyui_audio_velocity_compatibility: current FLOW_AV raw H3 audio velocity
experimental_sampling.status: experimental; does not replace or modify the stable dual-clock node

experimental_still_image_edit.status: experimental semantic reference editing; not mask-based pixel editing

validated_probe.scope: one perceptual probe; not a broad quality benchmark

experimental_long_video.state_strategy: CPU tail-only safetensors, exact N-1 slot, checksum validation, atomic replace
experimental_long_video.accepted_state_strategy: candidate preview is non-mutating; accepted manifest uses a lock, SHA-256, atomic replace, one valid backup, parent-candidate identity, and explicit downstream invalidation on replacement
experimental_long_video.model_patch_scope: cloned MODEL object patch; no process-global PackedLayout or MiniMaxH3 monkey patch
experimental_long_video.video_context_strategy: direct sampler video-latent tail; no video VAE decode/re-encode
experimental_long_video.continuation_rule: non-final output reaches sampled tail; exact hidden-tail trim only on final segment
experimental_long_video.segment_output: ComfyUI core CreateVideo -> SaveVideo; avoids the tested VHS apad/-shortest audio underrun
experimental_long_video.orchestration: total duration is quantized once to 24fps; a fixed 17n+5 render window bounds every segment; accepted manifest length selects the next segment; global/per-segment prompt and fixed/increment/hash seeds are supported; steps, shifts, sampler and scheduler are emitted from the same plan to both sampling and candidate identity; a complete final manifest blocks downstream sampling

background_executor.activation: review_only is the safe default; auto_accept_and_continue must be selected explicitly and accepts every successful candidate without human review
background_executor.queue_rule: the start node snapshots the current API prompt in memory before expensive work; the terminal accepts one candidate and validates/queues exactly one next prompt
background_executor.retry_rule: 0-10 additional attempts per failed segment; the exact prompt is reused and resolution, frames, context, sampler, scheduler and seed are never silently reduced

release_policies.clear_execution_cache: default; explicitly sets unload_models=false and free_memory=true
release_policies.unload_all_models: strong global ComfyUI unload; it is not H3-only

background_executor.release_timing: the selected policy is requested after every durable acceptance, including continue, pause and final; failure preserves the accepted manifest and stops without regeneration
background_executor.prompt_snapshot_sanitization: ComfyUI runtime is_changed fingerprints are removed both when capturing and when requeueing a prompt so an advanced keep_loaded segment cannot become a false whole-graph cache hit
background_executor.persistence: background_job.json stores state and prompt SHA-256 but never the prompt body; after a ComfyUI restart the workflow must be queued once to reattach the in-memory prompt snapshot
background_executor.process_ownership: one OS-owned background_job.lock.v2 lease per chain rejects another ComfyUI process before generation and is released automatically on process death
background_executor.manifest_locking: OS-owned manifest.lock.v2 serializes same-host commits and releases on process death; live legacy locks are respected and dead legacy residue remains rollback-compatible
background_executor.disk_schema_migration: accepted manifests and background states use explicit schema-2 format markers; valid schema-1 files normalize in memory without read-time mutation, then upgrade on the next protected write while preserving the raw v1 manifest backup; unknown future schemas fail closed
background_executor.error_privacy: persisted errors use an allowlist and exclude ComfyUI current_inputs/current_outputs, media tensors, and prompt text
background_executor.composition: the final accepted manifest may be composed automatically; post-accept composition errors fail the job without retrying from an already-advanced manifest
